# Welcome to the open coworking space!

Meet other people who work and study remotely, exchange ideas and get more work done together.

## House rules

The room is shared by everyone in it. Please stick to these so it stays a good place to work.

1.   1
**Be kind.**Treat everyone with respect. No harassment, hate speech or discrimination of any kind.

2.   2
**Respect people who are focusing.**Many are here to get work done. Ask before you start a conversation, and take a no gracefully.

3.   3
**Keep the noise down.**Mute your microphone when you are not talking, and take longer chats away from the desks.

4.   4
**Keep it safe for work.**That goes for your camera, your screen shares, your name and the chat.

5.   5
**Respect privacy.**Don't record or screenshot other people without asking them first.

# A computer  
for your agents.

Got an old laptop? Boot it from a USB stick and it becomes a machine your agents run as root, with their own desktop. It takes just 5 minutes.

$`curl -fsSL https://agency.makors.xyz/flash | sh`

Writes the installer (2.8 GB) to a USB stick. On Windows, [download the ISO](https://agency.makors.xyz/#download) instead.

## Why not DIY?

| Yourself | agency |
| --- | --- |
| Install Linux and encrypt the disk | One USB stick |
| Set up SSH and Tailscale | Ready at first boot |
| Install and sign in each agent | Picked during setup |
| Explain the machine to every agent | They already know it |
| Wire up Xvfb and VNC | Desktops in a browser tab |
| Hope a change doesn't break it | `agency rollback` |

## Features

*   ### Agents know the machine

Skills for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode.

*   ### Root, with an undo

Every change is a commit.

*   ### Desktops you can watch

Or take over, from a browser.
